cards.front: Someone says, “I’ll tell you later,” not “I will turn my head.” Which word fits that later/by-and-by sense?
cards.back: 回头. 回头告诉你 = I’ll tell you later. It can literally mean turn one’s head, but in speech often means later.
cards.retrievalTarget: Interpret 回头 as either turning back/one's head or conversational “later.”
cards.reason: Contrasts literal and conversational uses without putting the answer on the front.

cards.front: A warehouse, database, or code library is a place things are stored. Which bound noun gives that storage-place idea?
cards.back: 库. 仓库 = warehouse [仓 = storehouse]; 数据库 = database [数据 = data]; 书库 = book collection/library.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize 库 as a storage-place morpheme in warehouse, database, and library compounds.
cards.reason: Builds a stable semantic link across common compounds; extra compound parts are glossed.

gloss: to be in charge; manager/person responsible

cards.front: At work, one person is responsible for this area and can make decisions. Which word names that person or role?
cards.back: 主管. 他是销售主管 = he is the sales manager/person in charge [销售 = sales]. 主管 can be noun or verb: 主管这件事 = be in charge of this matter.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 主管 for the person or role in charge of an area.
cards.reason: Targets role meaning and noun/verb flexibility; one extra work noun is glossed inline.

cards.front: Which answer/reply morpheme appears in 回答 and 答案?
cards.back: 答. 回答 = answer/reply; 答案 = answer/key [案 = case/plan]. 单独说 答 is more written or bound than 回答.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize 答 as the answer/reply morpheme in 回答 and 答案.
cards.reason: Simple bound-morpheme card kept for reading compounds; extra 案 is glossed.

cards.front: A child studies hard, so the parents give a prize to encourage him: 父母___他。
cards.back: 父母奖励他. 奖励 is a reward given for good behavior or achievement; 礼物 is just a gift.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 奖励 for rewarding someone as encouragement for achievement or good behavior.
cards.reason: Production cue distinguishes reward from ordinary gift; support vocabulary is HSK1-4.

cards.front: Formal writing says something happens “under this condition/pressure,” not physically below a table. Which phrase?
cards.back: 之下. 在这种压力之下 = under this kind of pressure [压力 = pressure]. It is written/formal compared with 下面.
cards.retrievalTarget: Interpret 之下 as formal “under/beneath” for conditions, pressure, or limits.
cards.reason: Targets formal abstract use; one extra noun is glossed inline.

cards.front: The animal is a bear. In northern colloquial speech, the same character can mean scold someone. Which word is this?
cards.back: 熊. 熊猫 has the animal sense; colloquial 熊孩子 can mean a badly behaved child [孩子 = child]. The “scold” sense is regional/colloquial.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize 熊 primarily as bear, with regional colloquial scold/weak extensions.
cards.reason: Keeps the main reading stable while warning about less central extensions; extra phrase is glossed.

cards.front: An older text describes grass, sky, or youth with one color/age morpheme that is not simply modern 蓝 or 绿. Which character?
cards.back: 青. 青 can cover blue-green/dark green and also youth/young, as in 青年 = youth/young person.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize 青 as blue-green/dark green and as the youth/young morpheme.
cards.reason: Prevents over-narrow color mapping and links the youth sense; support words are basic.

cards.front: A report says someone met with a sad bad outcome. Which word means unfortunate/misfortune, stronger than simply 不好?
cards.back: 不幸. 不幸的是… = unfortunately…; 一个不幸的消息 = unfortunate sad news/report [消息 = news/report].
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 不幸 for unfortunate events, misfortune, or “unfortunately.”
cards.reason: Targets tone and adverbial pattern; one support noun is glossed inline.

cards.front: In physics, food, or motivational talk, which noun names energy rather than ability alone?
cards.back: 能量. 食物给人能量 = food gives people energy. 能力 is ability/capability; 能量 is energy or force/resources.
cards.retrievalTarget: Distinguish 能量 “energy” from 能力 “ability.”
cards.reason: Near-form contrast removes ambiguity; Chinese support is HSK1-4 plus target.

cards.front: Two statements or two people cannot both fit together; there is a contradiction/conflict. Which noun/adjective?
cards.back: 矛盾. 这两句话很矛盾 = these two sentences contradict each other. 他们之间有矛盾 = there is conflict between them.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 矛盾 for contradiction between ideas or conflict between people/interests.
cards.reason: Covers idea-conflict and people-conflict without extra unknown scaffolding.

cards.front: Spring, a new age, or a moment arrives in a written/formal style. Which word is more event-like than 来?
cards.back: 到来. 春天的到来 = the arrival of spring; 新时代到来了 = a new era has arrived [时代 = era].
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 到来 for the arrival/advent of times, events, or seasons.
cards.reason: Targets formal event-arrival use; one extra noun is glossed inline.

gloss: to clear up; tidy up; dispose of

cards.front: You remove old files or trash so the place/system is clean: 我需要___一下。
cards.back: 我需要清理一下. 清理 means clear up/tidy/dispose of, often by removing unwanted things; 打扫 is more sweep/clean a room.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 清理 for clearing out unwanted things, files, trash, or a messy place.
cards.reason: Production cue distinguishes clearing-out from general cleaning; support is basic.

gloss: to reach a deal; deal completed

cards.front: After bargaining, both sides agree and the deal is done. What do you say?
cards.back: 成交. 好，成交！ = OK, deal! It marks that a trade/contract has been completed.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 成交 to mark that a deal or transaction has been reached/completed.
cards.reason: High-value transactional phrase; no extra Chinese unknowns needed.

cards.front: Before summarizing a long explanation, which phrase means “in short / to put it in one sentence”?
cards.back: 一句话. 一句话，他不想去 = in short, he doesn’t want to go. Literally “one sentence,” but often a summary marker.
cards.retrievalTarget: Interpret 一句话 as a discourse marker meaning “in short / to sum up.”
cards.reason: Focuses on discourse-marker use rather than literal components; support words are basic.

cards.front: A report says someone killed themself. Which word names suicide, not killing another person?
cards.back: 自杀. 自 means self; 杀 is kill. 他自杀了 = he died by suicide.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize 自杀 as suicide / killing oneself, distinct from 杀 someone else.
cards.reason: Sensitive meaning is explicit and unambiguous; support vocabulary is HSK1-4 plus target.

cards.front: In a project, which noun names the person who carries responsibility and is in charge?
cards.back: 负责人. 请找负责人 = please find the person in charge. It is the responsible person, not just any worker.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 负责人 for the responsible person/person in charge of work or an organization.
cards.reason: Clear role distinction; Chinese example uses familiar words plus target.

cards.front: Which side morpheme appears in 旁边 and in character-component names like 木字___?
cards.back: 旁. 旁边 = beside/side. 木字旁 = the wood component on the side of a character.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize 旁 as “side/beside,” including character-component names like 木字旁.
cards.reason: Useful reading/character meta-vocabulary; support terms are basic or explained inline.

cards.front: You want not a short answer, but a detailed explanation: 请说得___一点。
cards.back: 请说得详细一点. 详细 means detailed/in detail; 仔细 is careful/attentive.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 详细 for detailed information, explanation, or description.
cards.reason: Production cue contrasts detail with carefulness; support vocabulary is HSK1-4.

gloss: to insert; stick in; take part in

cards.front: You put a card into a machine or add a sentence in the middle of talk. Which verb means insert/stick in?
cards.back: 插. 插卡 = insert a card; 插话 = cut in/add words while others speak. It is not general 放 “put.”
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 插 for inserting something into a slot, space, or conversation.
cards.reason: Connects physical insertion and conversational interruption with basic scaffolding.

cards.front: Police, a reader, or a researcher has a lead that helps follow the case/story. Which word means clue?
cards.back: 线索. 找到线索 = find a clue/lead. It can also mean the thread running through a story.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 线索 for clues/leads and the thread of a story or investigation.
cards.reason: Stable semantic image; no unglossed higher Chinese support is required.

cards.front: The food smells bad, not fragrant: 这个菜很___。
cards.back: 这个菜很臭. 臭 is bad-smelling/stinky; 香 is fragrant or tasty-smelling.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 臭 (chòu) for bad smells or stinky/repulsive things.
cards.reason: Concrete production target with a clear 香 contrast; support vocabulary is basic.

cards.front: Same character, rare reading: in scientific/formal words about the sense of smell, which reading is used?
cards.back: xiù. 嗅觉 is smell/sense of smell [嗅 = smell; 觉 = sense/feeling]. The common “stinky” reading is chòu.
cards.retrievalTarget: Read 臭 as xiù only in rare/formal smell-sense contexts, not ordinary “stinky.”
cards.reason: Pronunciation guard for a rare reading; the non-target support word is glossed inline.

cards.front: An action breaks the law, not just a school rule or moral norm. Which adjective/verb?
cards.back: 违法. 这是违法的 = this is illegal. 违法行为 = illegal act [行为 = behavior/action].
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 违法 for illegal actions that violate the law.
cards.reason: Separates legal violation from generic wrongness; one support noun is glossed.

gloss: pile; heap; to pile up; a lot of

cards.front: A messy mass of books or work sits together in a heap: 一___书 / 一___事。
cards.back: 一堆书 / 一堆事. 堆 is a pile/heap and can informally mean a lot of things.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 堆 for piles/heaps and 一堆 for a lot/a pile of items or tasks.
cards.reason: Classifier-like collocation is production useful; Chinese support is HSK1-4.

cards.front: A survey or medical text needs the formal category “male,” not simply 男人. Which word?
cards.back: 男性. 男性用户 = male users [用户 = users]; 男性健康 = men’s/male health. It is formal/category-like.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 男性 for formal/category “male,” distinct from everyday 男人.
cards.reason: Register/category contrast; one support noun is glossed inline.

gloss: product; item; grade; character; to taste/judge

cards.front: Which bound character gives 商品, 产品, and 作品 their “item/product/work” feel?
cards.back: 品. 商品 = goods; 产品 = product; 作品 = created work. 品 often means an item/type/quality in compounds.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize 品 as the item/product/quality morpheme in common compounds.
cards.reason: Compound-family card for a duplicated source item; examples are common and semantically transparent.

gloss: product; item; grade; character; to taste/judge

cards.front: In 品茶 or 品一品, the action is not buying a product. What kind of careful action is it?
cards.back: 品 can mean taste/sample and judge carefully. 品茶 = taste tea; 品一品 = taste/consider it carefully.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize 品 as “taste/sample/judge carefully” in verb uses like 品茶.
cards.reason: Uses the duplicate row to cover a distinct verb sense; front does not give the answer away.

cards.front: You gather stamps, data, or examples from many places: 我在___资料。
cards.back: 我在收集资料 = I am collecting materials/data. 收集 focuses on gathering items together over time.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 收集 for collecting/gathering items, data, examples, or materials.
cards.reason: Production cue covers concrete and information objects; support terms are basic.

cards.front: On TV, radio, or a video site, which word means the channel you watch or follow?
cards.back: 频道. 换频道 = change channels; 这个频道 = this channel. 道 here is not a road but a channel/path.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 频道 for TV/radio/media channels or frequency channels.
cards.reason: Modern media sense is clear; Chinese support is basic plus target.

cards.front: Written style: one fact causes another result. Which verb links cause to result, as in “rain made the road hard to walk”?
cards.back: 使得. 大雨使得路很难走 = heavy rain made the road hard to walk [大雨 = heavy rain]. It is more written than 让.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 使得 as a written/formal cause-result linker meaning “make/cause.”
cards.reason: Targets the common written causative use; one support phrase is glossed inline.

cards.front: Someone looks back to earlier years and says “back then / in those days.” Which time word?
cards.back: 当年. 当年我还小 = back then I was still young. It points to a remembered past period, not this year.
cards.retrievalTarget: Interpret 当年 as “back then / in those days” for a past period.
cards.reason: Clear temporal contrast with 年 literal/current-year readings; support words are basic.

cards.front: A small box/case of medicine, tea, or food: 一___药 / 一___茶。
cards.back: 一盒药 / 一盒茶. 盒 is a box/case and also works as the classifier for a boxful.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 盒 for small boxes/cases and as a classifier for a box of something.
cards.reason: Simple classifier/container card; Chinese support is HSK1-4 plus target.

cards.front: A plan has not enough money or experience; a formal report names the deficiency. Which word?
cards.back: 不足. 经验不足 = insufficient experience; 资金不足 = funds are insufficient [资金 = funds]. It can be adjective or noun.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 不足 for insufficiency or a deficiency, especially in formal evaluation.
cards.reason: Targets formal lack/deficiency; one support noun is glossed inline.

cards.front: You tell someone strongly before danger or punishment: 我___过你。
cards.back: 我警告过你 = I warned you. 警告 is stronger/formal warning, often before danger, rules, or consequences.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 警告 for a strong or formal warning.
cards.reason: Production phrase is common and not answer-revealing; support vocabulary is basic.

gloss: to call/report to police; sound an alarm

cards.front: There is a theft or danger, so you call the police. Which verb?
cards.back: 报警. 快报警！ = call the police quickly! It can also mean an alarm device sounds.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 报警 for reporting to police/calling police, and recognize the alarm-sounding sense.
cards.reason: High-value emergency verb; no unglossed higher support is needed.

cards.front: A company talks about the work/services it provides, not “business” as a shop. Which formal noun?
cards.back: 业务. 银行业务 = banking services/business [银行 = bank]; 主要业务 = main business/service area.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 业务 for a company’s professional work, service line, or business area.
cards.reason: Captures enterprise/service sense; one support noun is glossed inline.

cards.front: A formal sign or license talks about operating a car, ship, or plane. Which verb is more formal than 开车?
cards.back: 驾驶. 驾驶汽车 = drive a car; 驾驶飞机 = pilot a plane. 开车 is everyday for driving a car.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 驾驶 for formal driving/piloting/operating vehicles.
cards.reason: Register contrast with 开车; support vocabulary is familiar.

gloss: to ride/take; make use of; multiply

cards.front: A sign says “take bus/train/plane” in a formal way. Which verb can also mean multiply in math?
cards.back: 乘. 乘公共汽车 = take a bus; 乘火车 = take a train. In math, 三乘二 = three times two.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize 乘 as formal “ride/take transport” and as math “multiply.”
cards.reason: Links two high-frequency readings; transport words are HSK1-4.

gloss: A; first; shell/armor; nail in compounds

cards.front: In contracts or lists, one party is labeled “A” or “the first side.” Which formal character often marks that role?
cards.back: 甲. 甲方 = Party A [方 = side/party]; 第一甲 = first grade/group. In 指甲, it means nail/shell-like covering.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize 甲 as formal “A/first party” and as shell/nail in compounds.
cards.reason: Bound formal morpheme is kept with compound-based recognition; one compound part is glossed.

cards.front: A book is officially brought out by a press. Which verb means publish, not merely post online?
cards.back: 出版. 这本书出版了 = this book was published. 出版社 = publishing house [社 = society/agency].
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 出版 for formal publication of books, magazines, or editions.
cards.reason: Separates publishing from generic release/posting; one compound part is glossed.

cards.front: Something feels almost magical or miraculous, not just good: 这个地方很___。
cards.back: 这个地方很神奇. 神奇 means magical/miraculous/amazing, often because it feels beyond ordinary explanation.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 神奇 for magical, miraculous, or strangely amazing things.
cards.reason: Production cue distinguishes wonder from generic quality; support vocabulary is basic.

cards.front: A doctor identifies what illness someone has. Which medical verb means diagnose?
cards.back: 诊断. 医生诊断出问题 = the doctor diagnosed/identified the problem. 诊断结果 = diagnosis result.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 诊断 for medical or technical diagnosis/identification of a problem.
cards.reason: Concrete professional action with extension to technical problems; support words are basic.

gloss: scissors; to cut with scissors; trim

cards.front: You cut hair or paper with scissors: 我想___头发。
cards.back: 我想剪头发. 剪 means cut with scissors/trim; 切 is cutting with a knife or slicing.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 剪 for cutting or trimming with scissors, especially hair/paper.
cards.reason: Tool-based contrast with 切; Chinese support is HSK1-4.

cards.front: A rocket is launched, a bullet is fired, or a signal is emitted. Which verb covers this sending-out action?
cards.back: 发射. 发射火箭 = launch a rocket [火箭 = rocket]; 发射信号 = send/emit a signal [信号 = signal].
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 发射 for launching/firing/emitting projectiles, rockets, or signals.
cards.reason: Unifies projectile and signal senses; extra technical nouns are glossed inline.

cards.front: Colloquial: use your brain! 动动___！
cards.back: 动动脑子！脑子 = brains/mind in everyday speech. 大脑 [anatomical/formal brain] is another, more medical term.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 脑子 for colloquial brains/mind in everyday speech.
cards.reason: High-value colloquial body/mind word; support phrase is basic.

cards.front: Success came at a high cost — not just money, but time, health, or loss. Which word captures that broader cost?
cards.back: 代价. 付出很大的代价 = pay a big price/cost. 价格 is market price; 代价 is cost/sacrifice/consequence.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 代价 for cost as sacrifice or consequence, not ordinary market price.
cards.reason: Separates sacrifice-cost from price; Chinese support is HSK1-4.

gloss: bureau chief; head of a bureau

cards.front: The head of a government bureau/office: 他是这个局的___。
cards.back: 他是这个局的局长. 局 = bureau/office; 局长 = bureau chief. Pattern: department/office + 长.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 局长 for the head/chief of a bureau or government office.
cards.reason: Common official-title pattern; support vocabulary is basic.

cards.front: The subway is very crowded, people are squeezed together: 地铁里太___了。
cards.back: 地铁里太挤了. 挤 can describe crowded conditions or the action of squeezing/pressing: 挤进去 = squeeze in.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 挤 for crowded conditions and squeezing/pressing actions.
cards.reason: Concrete urban-life adjective/verb; support vocabulary is HSK1-4.

cards.front: Northern colloquial speech uses a casual verb for “look/see,” including “see a doctor.” Which word?
cards.back: 瞧. 你瞧！ = look!/see! 瞧病 = see a doctor. It is more northern/colloquial than 看.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize 瞧 as colloquial “look/see,” especially in northern speech.
cards.reason: Register/regional contrast with neutral 看; Chinese support is basic plus target.

cards.front: You type keywords to find information online: 在网上___。
cards.back: 在网上搜索. 搜索 = search the web, a database, or a place. 搜 is the shorter everyday form.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 搜索 for systematic searching of places, databases, or the web.
cards.reason: Common digital-age verb; support vocabulary is HSK1-4.

cards.front: After eating too much, your stomach hurts: ___疼。
cards.back: 胃疼. 胃 = stomach. 胃口 = appetite [口 = mouth/taste]; 胃病 = stomach illness.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 胃 for stomach and common stomach-related compounds.
cards.reason: Simple body-part noun with useful compounds; one extension is glossed inline.

cards.front: The room where you cook food: 妈妈在___做饭。
cards.back: 妈妈在厨房做饭. 厨房 = kitchen; 房 is room. Classifier: 间.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 厨房 for kitchen.
cards.reason: Concrete room noun; support vocabulary is HSK1-4.

cards.front: Formal writing says “within this time/range,” not physical inside a box. Which phrase?
cards.back: 之内. 在三天之内 = within three days. 在这个范围之内 = within this scope [范围 = scope]. More written than 里面.
cards.retrievalTarget: Interpret 之内 as formal “within/inside” for time, ranges, or abstract scope.
cards.reason: Matches the formal postposition pattern; one support noun is glossed inline.

cards.front: You create an account on a website: 请先___一个账号。
cards.back: 请先注册一个账号. 注册 = register/enroll [账号 = account]. Also: 注册公司 = register a company.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 注册 for registering accounts, companies, or enrollment.
cards.reason: Common digital/bureaucratic verb; one support noun is glossed inline.

cards.front: Which one-syllable room/hall word appears in 餐厅, 客厅, and 办公厅?
cards.back: 厅. 餐厅 = dining hall/restaurant; 客厅 = living room [客 = guest]; 办公厅 = office hall/department [办公 = office work].
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize 厅 as a hall/room/department morpheme in compounds.
cards.reason: Bound-morpheme recognition card; compound parts are familiar or glossed.

cards.front: A written sentence says one thing changes together with another: ___时间过去，事情变了。
cards.back: 随着时间过去，事情变了 = as time passed, things changed. 随着 marks one change accompanying another.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 随着 as “along with / as X happens” to mark accompanying change.
cards.reason: Discourse connector is production-relevant; support words are basic.

cards.front: Someone helped you; you want to give something back. In another context, you report results back. Which word covers both?
cards.back: 回报. 回报社会 = give back to society; 回报结果 = report back results. 回 = return; 报 = repay/report.
cards.retrievalTarget: Distinguish 回报 as reciprocate/give back from 回报 as report back.
cards.reason: Links two senses through the return/report components; support vocabulary is basic.

cards.front: A painting reveals the artist’s feelings: 这幅画___了作者的感情。
cards.back: 这幅画展现了作者的感情. 展现 = reveal/display/unfold [感情 = feelings/emotion]. More unfolding than simple 显示.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 展现 for revealing, displaying, or unfolding before one's eyes.
cards.reason: Distinctive reveal/display image; one support noun is glossed inline.

cards.front: Before a big decision, experts evaluate the situation: 专家___了情况。
cards.back: 专家评估了情况. 评估 = evaluate/assess [情况 = situation]. It is more formal than 看看 or 判断 [judge/decide].
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 评估 for formal evaluation or assessment.
cards.reason: Formal evaluation verb with clear production cue; support noun is glossed inline.
